A newly disclosed Linux kernel vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-99288 and dubbed NoisyTCP, can enable an unauthenticated remote attacker to crash vulnerable Linux systems by sending specially crafted TCP traffic to an exposed listening service. The issue resides in the kernel TCP networking subsystem and can affect common server workloads such as Nginx, Apache, and SSH […]
